fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Fix honojs/hono#5060: make parseBody() and validator() match Content-Type media types case-insensitively (Application/JSON, Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded, mixed-case multipart/form-data), while keeping parameters such as the multipart boundary in their original case.
summary.issue_fit: Full — both code paths named in issue #5060 (body.ts's startsWith guard, validator.ts's regexes) are fixed, and buffer.ts's bufferToFormData now normalizes only the media-type prefix before handing the body to the platform's Response.formData(), so the boundary parameter keeps its original case. All three suggested tests from the issue are present and pass.
summary.coverage: All 6 changed files (body.ts, body.test.ts, buffer.ts, buffer.test.ts, validator.ts, validator.test.ts) read in full at base and head via the merge-base diff; traced callers (src/request.ts's HonoRequest.parseBody/arrayBuffer/formData caching, src/middleware/method-override/index.ts's parseBody(clonedRequest)) and repository guidance (only .github/pull_request_template.md exists; no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rules apply). No packet or forge access was available or needed: this is a local range review (main→review-head), not a live pull-request fetch.
check_details: Reviewer ran `./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run --project main --coverage.enabled=false src/utils/body.test.ts src/utils/buffer.test.ts` at head 5226d416: 50 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing, unrelated).
Reviewer ran the same vitest invocation against `src/validator/validator.test.ts` at head 5226d416: 56 passed.

Reviewer ran the same vitest invocation against `src/request.test.ts` and `src/middleware/method-override/index.test.ts` at head 5226d416 to check for regressions in body-consumption caching: 49 passed, including the pre-existing 'should parse form data' case that calls parseBody() then text()/arrayBuffer()/bytes()/blob() on the same HonoRequest.
Reviewer ran `src/middleware/csrf/index.test.ts` and `src/hono.test.ts` at head 5226d416 as a broader regression check on request-body handling: 237 passed.

codecov (github-actions comment, supplied, not reviewer-executed): patch coverage 76.47% on this diff, project coverage 79.08% (-0.01%); historical context only, not a correctness signal on its own — no candidate depended on the uncovered lines.

observations.fact: src/utils/body.ts's parseFormData now buffers the whole request body via arrayBuffer() and re-wraps it in a synthetic Response before calling formData(), instead of calling the platform Request's formData() directly as before; this mirrors the pattern already used in validator.ts's 'form' branch and is required so the normalized (lower-cased) Content-Type reaches the platform's own media-type check.

requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:104-106 lower-cases the media-type portion of Content-Type before comparing (`contentType?.split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase()`); src/utils/buffer.ts:106-117 lower-cases only the media-type prefix via `contentType.replace(/^[^;]+/, ...)`, leaving parameters like the multipart boundary untouched; src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 adds the `i` flag to jsonRegex/multipartRegex/urlencodedRegex. Verified passing at head via the vitest runs in check_details. A compatibility premise (does this break any documented/relied-upon prior behavior?) was independently verified by a fresh-context worker and ruled `holds`: no docs, JSDoc, CHANGELOG, or existing test treats the old case-sensitive rejection as an intentional contract — the changed inputs previously only produced a silently empty/unvalidated result, which issue #5060 identifies as the bug.

src/utils/body.test.ts adds 'should parse mixed-case `x-www-form-urlencoded`' and 'should parse mixed-case `multipart/form-data`'; src/validator/validator.test.ts adds 'Should validate if Content-Type media type is mixed-case' (json), 'Should validate mixed-case URL Encoded Content-Type' and 'Should validate mixed-case multipart/form-data Content-Type' (form), each asserting the parsed/validated payload, not just a status code; src/utils/buffer.test.ts adds a boundary-preservation test ('...while keeping the boundary'). All pass at head.
6 new test cases added across body.test.ts (+2), buffer.test.ts (+1), and validator.test.ts (+3), covering every combination named in the issue.
Reviewer independently re-ran the affected suites at head 5226d416 (see check_details); all pass.
